discord.text:
**Newsroom brief: SINGLE-SOURCE REPORT - REUTERS | Reuters reports Southwest's 2026 profit outlook cut despite quarterly gains [Source 2026-10-21]**

Reuters reports Southwest cut its 2026 profit outlook despite a quarterly earnings beat.

**Context:** If the report is accurate, the serious countercase to a failing-turnaround narrative is the reported improvement in adjusted operating margin despite higher fuel costs.

Read the article: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication-5acee7b9d83918a3

Source date: 2026-10-21. Interpretation remains analysis.
